definitions.full: H3115. Yokebed יוֺכֶ֫בֶד proper name, feminine ᵐ5 Ἰωχαβεδ ( ׳י is glory ; compare Phoenician כבדמלקרת ) daughter of Levi, wife of Amram and mother of Moses Exod 6:20 ; Num 26:59 (both P). יוּכַל see יְהוּכַל . p. 220. יוֺנָדָב see יְהוֺנָדָב . p. 220. יוֺנָתָן see יְהוֺנָתָן . p. 220.

occurrences.englishText: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.
The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
